supersedes: MA-SQLGRID-EXTERNAL-ANNOTATION-PILOT-v1.0 (SHA-256 6D5A0398083DEF9762295E13365636CA4AE9434B785371E88DF9773AC1DD1FF5); pilot outputs remain archived under runs/ma_pilot/ and are NOT reused
governance: Machine-adjudicated SILVER labels only. The 91 candidates are AUTO_CANDIDATE, not human gold; outputs must never be reported as external gold accuracy.
reason_for_revision: Pilot (25 items) showed A/B agreement 1.00 with all semantically_correct=true: the sample had no discriminating power. v1.1 adds a blinded negative-control set (deterministically perturbed wrong SQL) so annotator error-detection can be measured, and extends scope to all 91 candidates.

task.unit: one external grid-domain question + one candidate SQL + schema context + deterministic execution facts
task.scope: ALL 91 original candidates PLUS 30 blinded negative controls (see negative_controls)
task.input_to_annotators: unchanged from v1.0; annotators cannot distinguish originals from negatives (identical prompt form)

negative_controls.generation: deterministic script with seed 20260807; source = 30 sampled originals (15 RTS + 15 SimBench); exactly one perturbation applied per control
perturbation_families: drop_filter: remove the WHERE clause (or one ANDed predicate)
wrong_filter_value: replace a string literal in WHERE with a different plausible value from the same column domain
wrong_column: swap one SELECT column for another column of the same table
drop_order: remove ORDER BY when the question implies ordering/limit
negative_controls.registration: controls get ids NEG_<source_question_id>__<family>; the manifest maps control id -> source id, family, expected verdict semantically_correct=false; annotator prompts never reveal control status
negative_controls.sandbox: controls go through the same read-only execution step; most remain executable (that is the point: executability is not correctness)
negative_controls.success_criterion: blinded detection rate = fraction of controls where the final label has semantically_correct=false; reported per family; no fixed pass threshold, but a rate below 0.7 must be flagged as an annotator-reliability limitation in the report

prompt_template: unchanged from v1.0 (question id is echoed in the [QUESTION] line as in the pilot fix)
agreement_metrics: v1.0 metrics PLUS blinded negative detection rate (overall and per family)
stop_conditions: 5 consecutive auth or format failures for one model -> halt and report
served model id differs from frozen id (DeepSeek rolling alias deepseek-v4-flash excepted) -> halt and report
total stage-2 calls exceed the budget in STAGE2_AUTHORIZATION_20260807.json -> halt
ledger_requirements: unchanged from v1.0; stage-2 outputs go to runs/ma_stage2/ and must not overwrite runs/ma_pilot/
